en: The sky's on mute and so is the queue. Monday hasn't found the volume.
af: Die lug is op stil en die ry ook. Maandag het nog nie sy volume gekry nie.
xh: Isibhakabhaka sithe cwaka, nomgca uthe cwaka. UMvulo akakayifumani ivolyum.

en: Sky and sea agreed on a colour this morning. Not an exciting one.
af: Lug en see het vanoggend oor 'n kleur ooreengekom. Nie 'n opwindende een nie.
xh: Isibhakabhaka nolwandle bavumelene ngombala ngale ntsasa. Asingombala onomdla.

en: Even the hadeda is keeping it down. The sky set the tone.
af: Selfs die hadida hou dit sag. Die lug het die toon aangegee.
xh: Nditsho ne-hadeda ithe cwaka. Isibhakabhaka simisele umzekelo.

en: No shadows, no glare, no excuses. Monday under a Tupperware lid.
af: Geen skaduwees, geen skittering, geen verskonings nie. Maandag onder 'n Tupperware-deksel.
xh: Akukho zithunzi, akukho kukhazimla, akukho zizathu. UMvulo uphantsi kwesiciko seTupperware.

en: The sun won't be inspecting the shine today. The car is fine with that.
af: Die son gaan nie vandag die blink kom inspekteer nie. Die kar is tevrede.
xh: Ilanga alizukuza kujonga ukukhazimla namhlanje. Imoto ayinangxaki ngaloo nto.

en: Not one shadow on the field all day. The umpire never had to squint.
af: Nie een skaduwee op die veld die hele dag nie. Die skeidsregter het nie een keer sy oë op skrefies getrek nie.
xh: Akukho sithunzi nesinye ebaleni imini yonke. Usompempe akazange azimeze amehlo.

en: Grey sky, jerseys on, school's out. The weekend doesn't need the sun's permission.
af: Grys lug, truie aan, skool is uit. Die naweek vra nie die son se toestemming nie.
xh: Isibhakabhaka singwevu, iijezi zinxitywe, isikolo siphumile. Impelaveki ayidingi mvume yelanga.

en: The whole veld with the colour turned down. The sheep count the same either way.
af: Die hele veld met die kleur afgedraai. Die skape tel dieselfde, hoe ook al.
xh: Ithafa lonke ngathi umbala uthotyiwe. Iigusha zibalwa ngendlela efanayo noko.

en: The shed bulb is tonight's sunset. The cattle accept the downgrade.
af: Die skuur se gloeilamp is vanaand se sonsondergang. Die beeste aanvaar die afgradering.
xh: Isibane seshedi kukutshona kwelanga ngokuhlwanje. Iinkomo zamkela oko.

en: The sky went from light grey to dark grey. That was the whole show.
af: Die lug het van liggrys na donkergrys gegaan. Dit was die hele vertoning.
xh: Isibhakabhaka sisuke kungwevu olukhanyayo saya kungwevu olumnyama. Yayiyiyo yonke imiboniso leyo.

en: The security light came on early. The sun never properly clocked in.
af: Die sekuriteitslig het vroeg aangegaan. Die son het nooit behoorlik ingeklok nie.
xh: Isibane sokhuseleko sikhanyise kwangethuba. Ilanga alizange liqale umsebenzi kakuhle.

en: Sea and sky in matching grey. Only the pier lights made an effort.
af: See en lug in bypassende grys. Net die pier se liggies het moeite gedoen.
xh: Ulwandle nesibhakabhaka bangwevu ngokufanayo. Zizibane zebhulorho kuphela ezizamileyo.

en: The flag's giving the forecast before the surfers do. It says: go.
af: Die vlag gee die voorspelling voor die branderplankryers. Dit sê: gaan.
xh: Iflegi ixela imozulu phambi kwabadlali bamaza. Ithi: hambani.

en: The jacaranda petals are taking the bus too. The breeze bought their tickets.
af: Die jakarandablomme ry ook bus. Die bries het hulle kaartjies gekoop.
xh: Amagqabi eentyatyambo ze-jacaranda nawo akhwele ibhasi. Umoya omncinci uwathengele amatikiti.

en: The windpump is doing the morning's work. The grass is just waving it on.
af: Die windpomp doen die oggend se werk. Die gras waai hom net aan.
xh: Umpompo womoya wenza umsebenzi wakusasa. Ingca iyawuphungela nje isandla.

en: Hand on the cap, one stride at a time. The breeze is pacing her.
af: Hand op die pet, een tree op 'n slag. Die bries hou haar pas.
xh: Isandla ekepusini, inyathelo ngenyathelo. Umoya omncinci uhamba naye.

en: The washing will be dry before first break. The breeze took the early shift.
af: Die wasgoed is droog voor eerste pouse. Die bries het vroeg begin werk.
xh: Impahla iza komelela phambi kwekhefu lokuqala. Umoya omncinci uqale umsebenzi kwangethuba.

en: A little dust devil is riding ahead of him. It isn't even pedalling.
af: 'n Klein stofduiweltjie ry voor hom uit. Dit trap nie eens nie.
xh: Isaqhwithi esincinci sothuli sihamba phambi kwakhe. Asiyityhali nokuyityhala ibhayisekile.

en: Her hair got to the bakery first. The breeze has its own Sunday plans.
af: Haar hare was eerste by die bakkery. Die bries het sy eie Sondagplanne.
xh: Iinwele zakhe zifike kuqala evenkileni yesonka. Umoya omncinci uneecebo zawo zangeCawa.

en: Break time, and the breeze is doing everyone's hair. Teachers included.
af: Pouse, en die bries doen almal se hare. Die juffrouens ook.
xh: Lixesha lekhefu, kwaye umoya omncinci ulungisa iinwele zabo bonke. Nootitshala.

en: The breeze is working the fruit stall today. Air-con included, no extra charge.
af: Die bries werk vandag by die vrugtestalletjie. Lugverkoeling ingesluit, geen ekstra koste nie.
xh: Umoya omncinci usebenza kwindawo yeziqhamo namhlanje. Ipholisa simahla, akukho mali yongezelelweyo.

en: The breeze does all the work. The kite takes all the credit.
af: Die bries doen al die werk. Die vlieër kry al die eer.
xh: Umoya omncinci wenza wonke umsebenzi. Ikhayithi ifumana lonke udumo.

en: The corner flag is pointing out exactly where the conversions will drift.
af: Die hoekvlag wys presies waarheen die doelskoppe gaan trek.
xh: Iflegi yekona ibonisa kanye apho ibhola iza kutyekela khona.

en: The sheets are dry already. Now the breeze is just showing off for the kid.
af: Die lakens is al droog. Nou spog die bries net vir die kind.
xh: Amashiti sele omile. Ngoku umoya omncinci uzibonakalisa nje kumntwana.

en: The smoke has found the neighbours' yard. Saturday's braai is officially a community event.
af: Die rook het die bure se erf gekry. Saterdag se braai is amptelik 'n gemeenskapsgeleentheid.
xh: Umsi ufike eyadini yabamelwane. Ibraai yangoMgqibelo ngoku yeyoluntu lonke.

en: Shoes on the blanket corners. The breeze is welcome, the sand isn't.
af: Skoene op die kombers se hoeke. Die bries is welkom, die sand nie.
xh: Izihlangu kwiikona zengubo. Umoya omncinci wamkelekile, isanti ayamkelekanga.

en: Flags out straight, wine held tight. The deck's version of a calm Monday.
af: Vlae styf uit, wynglas styf vas. Die dek se weergawe van 'n kalm Maandag.
xh: Iiflegi zolulekile, iwayini ibanjwe ngokuqinileyo. Yile ndlela uMvulo ozolileyo ukhangeleka ngayo apha.

en: The dust is going for gold in the low light. The match plays on through it.
af: Die stof gaan vir goud in die laaste lig. Die wedstryd speel daardeur voort.
xh: Uthuli lukhazimla ngathi yigolide ekukhanyeni kokutshona kwelanga. Umdlalo uyaqhubeka.

en: The hill is moving in waves. The cattle have decided not to notice.
af: Die heuwel beweeg in golwe. Die beeste het besluit om dit nie raak te sien nie.
xh: Induli ishukuma ngathi ngamaza. Iinkomo zigqibe ekubeni zingaboni nto.

en: The breeze is moving the jacaranda one street over, petal by petal. The stoep approves.
af: Die bries skuif die jakaranda een straat aan, blommetjie vir blommetjie. Die stoep keur dit goed.
xh: Umoya omncinci uthutha i-jacaranda iye kwesinye isitrato, intyatyambo ngentyatyambo. Istoep siyavuma.

en: The washing should have come in hours ago. The breeze voted to leave it.
af: Die wasgoed moes ure gelede al in gewees het. Die bries het gestem om dit te los.
xh: Impahla bekufanele ingene kwiiyure ezidlulileyo. Umoya omncinci uvote ukuba ihlale.

en: The flags are still chatting. The boats have called it a week.
af: Die vlae gesels nog. Die bote het die week afgesluit.
xh: Iiflegi zisancokola. Izikhephe ziyigqibile iveki.

en: The leaves keep setting off the security light. The dog's stopped getting up for them.
af: Die blare laat die sekuriteitslig aanhoudend aanskakel. Die hond staan nie meer op daarvoor nie.
xh: Amagqabi asoloko ekhanyisa isibane sokhuseleko. Inja ayisaphakami ngenxa yawo.

en: Somebody forgot the washing. The breeze didn't, and it's doing a lovely job.
af: Iemand het die wasgoed vergeet. Die bries nie, en dit doen 'n pragtige werk.
xh: Umntu uyilibele impahla. Umoya omncinci awuyilibalanga, kwaye wenza umsebenzi omhle.

en: The breeze is still warm at this hour. The sea leaves the heating on all night.
af: Die bries is nog warm op hierdie uur. Die see los die verwarming die hele nag aan.
xh: Umoya omncinci usashushu ngeli xesha. Ulwandle lushiya isifudumezi sivuliwe ubusuku bonke.

en: The windpump doesn't believe in knock-off time. Neither does the dog.
af: Die windpomp glo nie aan afklopstyd nie. Die hond ook nie.
xh: Umpompo womoya awukholelwa kwixesha lokuphuma emsebenzini. Nenja ayikholelwa.

en: The breeze is taking the smoke down the block. The whole street knows what's for supper.
af: Die bries vat die rook met die straat af. Die hele buurt weet wat vir aandete is.
xh: Umoya omncinci uthwala umsi usiwa ezantsi kwesitrato. Isitrato sonke siyazi ukuba kutyiwa ntoni ngokuhlwa.

en: Every light on the string is swaying. Saturday night has rhythm, barely.
af: Elke liggie aan die string swaai. Saterdagaand het ritme, net-net.
xh: Zonke izibane ezisentanjeni ziyajiwuzela. UMgqibelo ebusuku unesingqi, kancinci nje.

en: The sand is crossing the road a grain at a time. Nobody here is in a hurry.
af: Die sand steek die pad oor, een korrel op 'n slag. Niemand hier het haas nie.
xh: Isanti iwela indlela ingqanga ngengqanga. Akukho mntu ungxamileyo apha.

en: The mountain pulled the duvet over its head. Fair enough, it's Friday.
af: Die berg het die duvet oor sy kop getrek. Verstaanbaar, dis Vrydag.
xh: Intaba izigqume intloko ngengubo. Kulungile, nguLwesihlanu.

en: Sun's in, sun's out. Monday's doing a soft launch.
af: Son in, son uit. Maandag warm nog net op.
xh: Ilanga liyangena, liyaphuma. UMvulo uqala kancinci.

en: The clouds gave the sun Tuesday off. Nobody told the humidity.
af: Die wolke het die son Dinsdag afgegee. Niemand het die klamheid laat weet nie.
xh: Amafu alinike ilanga ikhefu ngoLwesibini. Akukho mntu uxelele ubumanzi bomoya.

en: Those clouds are only passing through. Even the mealies know not to get excited.
af: Daai wolke is net op deurtog. Selfs die mielies raak nie opgewonde nie.
xh: Loo mafu adlula nje. Nditsho nombona uyazi ukuba akufuneki uvuye.

en: The shade is working down the rows one at a time. It's inspecting.
af: Die skaduwee werk die rye een vir een af. Dis besig met inspeksie.
xh: Isithunzi sihamba imigca ngemigca. Siyahlola.

en: Purple on the ground, white in the sky. Friday's colour scheme is approved.
af: Pers op die grond, wit in die lug. Vrydag se kleure is goedgekeur.
xh: Mfusa emhlabeni, mhlophe esibhakabhakeni. Imibala kaLwesihlanu yamkelwe.

en: A few clouds came along to watch. Also not running.
af: 'n Paar wolke het kom kyk. Hulle hardloop ook nie.
xh: Amafu ambalwa eze kubukela. Nawo akabaleki.

en: The clouds are drifting through slowly. It's Sunday; they're allowed.
af: Die wolke dryf stadig verby. Dis Sondag; hulle mag.
xh: Amafu adlula kancinci. YiCawa; avumelekile.

en: The mountain's tablecloth is only half on. It's Monday, nobody's fully dressed.
af: Die berg se tafeldoek is net half op. Dis Maandag, niemand is heeltemal aangetrek nie.
xh: Ilaphu letafile lentaba lingaphezulu ngesiqingatha kuphela. NguMvulo, akukho mntu unxibe ngokupheleleyo.

en: Cloud shadows crossing the outfield at a steady walk. Nobody's appealing.
af: Wolkskaduwees stap teen 'n rustige pas oor die veld. Niemand appelleer nie.
xh: Izithunzi zamafu ziwela ibala zihamba kancinci. Akukho mntu ukhalazayo.

en: Sun, then cloud, then sun. Even the monkeys can't plan around that.
af: Son, dan wolk, dan son. Selfs die apies kan nie daarvolgens beplan nie.
xh: Ilanga, emva koko ilifu, emva koko ilanga. Nditsho neenkawu azikwazi ukwenza icebo.

en: The dog found the exact line between sun and shade. He's staying put.
af: Die hond het die presiese lyn tussen son en skadu gekry. Hy bly net daar.
xh: Inja iwufumene kanye umda phakathi kwelanga nesithunzi. Ihlala khona.

en: Sunglasses on, sunglasses off, sunglasses on. Friday afternoon is interval training.
af: Sonbril op, sonbril af, sonbril op. Vrydagmiddag is intervaloefening.
xh: Iiglasi zelanga ziyanxitywa, ziyakhululwa, ziyanxitywa. Emva kwemini ngoLwesihlanu kukuzilolonga.

en: One cloud over the mountain is not a weather event. The fire stays lit.
af: Een wolk oor die berg is nie weer nie. Die vuur bly aan.
xh: Ilifu elinye phezu kwentaba asiyiyo imozulu. Umlilo uhlala uvutha.

en: Cloud over the mountain, potjie under the lapa. Both need another hour.
af: Wolk oor die berg, potjie onder die lapa. Albei kort nog 'n uur.
xh: Ilifu phezu kwentaba, ipotjie phantsi kwelapa. Zombini zisafuna enye iyure.

en: The clouds stayed late just for the colour. Monday owed everyone that much.
af: Die wolke het laat gebly net vir die kleur. Maandag skuld almal soveel.
xh: Amafu ahlale kade ngenxa yombala kuphela. UMvulo ebetyala wonke umntu oko.

en: Clouds all afternoon, not a drop. The hose is back on duty.
af: Wolke die hele middag, nie 'n druppel nie. Die tuinslang is weer aan diens.
xh: Amafu emva kwemini yonke, akukho thontsi. Umbhobho wamanzi ubuyele emsebenzini.

en: The sky's putting on a show. The fish, as usual, are not.
af: Die lug hou 'n vertoning. Die vis, soos gewoonlik, nie.
xh: Isibhakabhaka senza umboniso. Iintlanzi, njengesiqhelo, azenzi.

en: Clouds for the sunset, sprinklers for the vines. The farm arranges its own rain.
af: Wolke vir die sonsondergang, sproeiers vir die wingerd. Die plaas reël sy eie reën.
xh: Amafu okutshona kwelanga, amanzi okunkcenkceshela iidiliya. Ifama izilungiselela eyayo imvula.

en: The sun's clocked out. The clouds are still lit, and so is the balcony.
af: Die son het afgeteken. Die wolke gloei nog, en die balkon ook.
xh: Ilanga liphume emsebenzini. Amafu asakhanya, kunye nebhalkoni.

en: The clouds turned pink right on packing-up time. Nobody packed up.
af: Die wolke het pienk geword net toe dit tyd was om op te pak. Niemand het opgepak nie.
xh: Amafu abe pinki kanye ngexesha lokupakisha. Akukho mntu upakishileyo.

en: The cattle are home before the colour goes. Sunday ends exactly on schedule.
af: Die beeste is tuis voor die kleur weg is. Sondag eindig presies op tyd.
xh: Iinkomo zisekhaya phambi kokuba umbala uphele. ICawa iphela ngexesha kanye.

en: The moon's on a dimmer tonight. The security light has no such setting.
af: Die maan is vanaand op 'n dimmer. Die sekuriteitslig het nie so 'n knoppie nie.
xh: Inyanga ikhanya kancinci ngokuhlwanje. Isibane sokhuseleko asinako oko.

en: Half moon, half cloud, full bin. Tuesday night, as advertised.
af: Halfmaan, halfwolk, vol drom. Dinsdagaand, soos geadverteer.
xh: Isiqingatha senyanga, isiqingatha selifu, umgqomo ugcwele. NgoLwesibini ebusuku, njengoko kwakuthenjisiwe.

en: The moon keeps popping out to check on the forecourt. Still nothing happening.
af: Die maan loer kort-kort uit om die vulstasie te check. Steeds niks aan die gang nie.
xh: Inyanga isoloko iphuma ijonga igaraji. Akukho nto yenzekayo.

en: The clouds are passing the moon around. The balcony is happy to wait.
af: Die wolke gee die maan vir mekaar aan. Die balkon wag graag.
xh: Amafu ayayidlulisana inyanga. Ibhalkoni ivuya ukulinda.

en: The moon drops in between clouds. It can smell the meat from up there.
af: Die maan kom tussen die wolke deur kuier. Hy ruik die vleis van daar bo af.
xh: Inyanga ityelela phakathi kwamafu. Iyayiva ivumba lenyama ukusuka phaya phezulu.

en: Half the stars are behind cloud. The fairy lights are covering for them.
af: Die helfte van die sterre is agter wolke. Die liggies staan vir hulle in.
xh: Isiqingatha seenkwenkwezi singemva kwamafu. Izibane ezincinci zibathathela indawo.

en: Moon behind a cloud, dog on the stoep. Sunday's service is over.
af: Maan agter 'n wolk, hond op die stoep. Sondag se diens is verby.
xh: Inyanga ingemva kwelifu, inja isestoep. Inkonzo yangeCawa iphelile.

en: It's 6am and the fridge is already the most popular room in the house.
af: Dis 6 uur en die yskas is nou al die gewildste vertrek in die huis.
xh: Ngu-6 ngentsasa, kwaye ifriji sele iyeyona ndawo ithandwayo endlwini.

en: The dog is loving this wind. He's got the only hairstyle built for it.
af: Die hond geniet hierdie wind. Hy het die enigste haarstyl wat daarvoor gebou is.
xh: Inja iyawuthanda lo moya. Inenwele ekuphela kwazo ezenzelwe wona.

en: Properly cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys like they aren't there.
af: Behoorlik koud vandag. Die soort wat deur drie truie gaan asof hulle nie daar is nie.
xh: Kuyabanda nyhani namhlanje. Yingqele egqobhoza iijezi ezintathu ngathi azikho.

en: Even the people who swear it never gets cold are admitting it.
af: Selfs dié wat sweer dit word nooit koud nie, erken dit nou.
xh: Nditsho nabo bafunga ukuba akuze kubande ngoku bayavuma.

en: One breath of rain air and suddenly the whole country is a poet.
af: Een teug reënlug en skielik is almal in hierdie land 'n digter.
xh: Umphefumlo omnye womoya wemvula, ngequbuliso ilizwe lonke liyimbongi.

en: Rain on a farm isn't weather. It's a salary falling from the sky.
af: Reën op 'n plaas is nie weer nie. Dis 'n salaris wat val.
xh: Imvula efama ayiyiyo imozulu nje. Ngumvuzo owela esibhakabhakeni.

en: Wet tar at sunrise. That's not a smell, that's heritage.
af: Nat teer by sonsopkoms. Dis nie 'n reuk nie, dis 'n erfenis.
xh: ITar emanzi ekuphumeni kwelanga. Asilovumba elo, lilifa.

en: Joburg rain keeps a diary: 2pm sharp, maximum drama, no apologies.
af: Joburg se reën hou dagboek: 14:00, stiptelik, vol drama.
xh: Imvula yaseJoburg inedayari: ngo-2 emva kwemini kanye, idrama eninzi, akukho kuxolisa.

en: All plans are officially moved to 'when it clears up'. Which is never. Shame.
af: Alle afsprake is amptelik verskuif na 'wanneer dit opklaar'.
xh: Onke amacebo ngoku afuduselwe 'xa kuthe kwacaca'. Okungasoze kwenzeke. Hayi bo.

en: You smell Highveld rain before you see it. That's the trailer.
af: Jy ruik Hoëveldse reën voor jy hom sien. Dis die lokprent.
xh: Imvula yaseHighveld uyayiva ngevumba phambi kokuba uyibone. Yintshayelelo leyo.

en: To the dam levels! Every downpour is a round on the house.
af: Op die damvlakke! Elke bui is 'n rondte op die huis.
xh: Kumanqanaba amadama! Yonke imvula enkulu sisipho sasimahla.

en: Breaking news: the puddles are open for business.
af: Groot nuus: die plasse is oop vir besigheid.
xh: Iindaba ezintsha: amachibi avuliwe ngoku.

en: It's still fifty kilometres away and the stoep is already sold out.
af: Dis nog vyftig kilometer weg en die stoep is klaar vol.
xh: Isekude ngeekhilomitha ezingamashumi amahlanu, kodwa istoep sele sigcwele.

en: Early grey. Like the tea, just let it steep.
af: Vroeë grys — soos die tee, laat dit net trek.
xh: Ungwevu kusasa. Mayihlale nje kancinci, njengeti.

en: Grey is also a colour, says my ma. Today I believe her.
af: Grys is ook 'n kleur, sê my ma. Vandag glo ek haar.
xh: Ungwevu nawo ngumbala, utsho umama. Namhlanje ndiyamkholelwa.

en: The sky is in its interview suit: grey, neat, giving nothing away.
af: Die lug dra sy onderhoudspak: grys, netjies, sê niks.
xh: Isibhakabhaka sinxibe isuti yodliwano-ndlebe: ngwevu, icocekile, ayixeli nto.

en: Weekend grey: official permission to do absolutely nothing.
af: Naweek-grys: amptelike toestemming om niks te doen nie.
xh: Ungwevu wempelaveki: imvume esemthethweni yokungenzi nto konke konke.

en: Grey day equals baking day. Somebody's kitchen already smells amazing.
af: Grys dag is bak-dag. Iemand se kombuis ruik nou al lekker.
xh: Usuku olungwevu lusuku lokubhaka. Ikhitshi lomntu othile sele linuka kamnandi.

en: The sun clocked out without saying bye. Rude, but relatable.
af: Die son het uitgeklok sonder om te groet. Onbeskof, maar relatable.
xh: Ilanga liphume emsebenzini lingavalelisanga. Akukho mbeko, kodwa siyaqonda.

en: Dusk is on mute tonight. The evening showed up anyway.
af: Skemer op mute vanaand. Die aand het nogtans opgedaag.
xh: Ukutshona kwelanga kuthe cwaka ngokuhlwanje. Ubusuku bufikile noko.

en: The sky is under the covers. Yours are waiting. Coincidence? Never.
af: Die lug is oorgetrek. Jou bed ook. Toeval? Nooit.
xh: Isibhakabhaka sizigqumile. Iingubo zakho ziyakulinda. Kuyenzeka nje? Hayi.

en: The Doctor's on morning rounds. No appointment needed, unfortunately.
af: Die Dokter doen sy oggendrondtes. Geen afspraak nodig nie, ongelukkig.
xh: UGqirha uhamba ejonga kusasa. Akufuneki kubhukisha, ngelishwa.

en: The tablecloth is pressed and ready for tomorrow's service.
af: Die tafeldoek is gestryk en reg vir môre se diens.
xh: Ilaphu letafile lu-ayinile kwaye lilungele umsebenzi wangomso.

en: Cape cold is wet cold. It moves into your bones and unpacks.
af: Kaapse koue is nat koue. Dit klim in jou bene en pak uit.
xh: Ingqele yaseKapa yingqele emanzi. Ingena emathanjeni akho ize ihlale.

en: Highveld winter: sunburn and frostbite achievable on the same day.
af: Highveld winter: sonbrand en verkluiming op dieselfde dag moontlik.
xh: Ubusika baseHighveld: ukutshiswa lilanga nokubanjwa ngumkhenkce kunokwenzeka ngosuku olunye.

en: Close enough to admire, far enough that you don't have to shovel it. Perfect.
af: Naby genoeg om te bewonder, ver genoeg om nie te skep nie. Perfek.
xh: Kufutshane ngokwaneleyo ukuba ukuncome, kude ngokwaneleyo ukuba ungawuqhwanyazeli. Kugqibelele.

en: Wet sea cold: the kind that gets through four layers and a good mood.
af: Nat koue by die see: die soort wat deur vier lae en 'n goeie humeur trek.
xh: Ingqele emanzi yaselwandle: lolo hlobo lugqobhoza iingubo ezine nomoya omhle.

en: You can watch the cold arriving. It's not even being subtle about it.
af: Jy kan die koue sien inkom. Dit maak nie eers geheim daarvan nie.
xh: Uyayibona ingqele isiza. Ayizifihli konke konke.

en: We're visiting outside in the cold because inside is, honestly, colder.
af: Ons kuier buite in die koue want binne is dit, eerlikwaar, kouer.
xh: Sihleli phandle engqeleni kuba ngaphakathi, inyani, kubanda ngakumbi.

en: The blesbok wear no scarves and file no complaints. We could learn something. We won't, but we could.
af: Die blesbokke dra nie serpe nie en kla ook nie. Ons kan iets leer. Ons gaan nie, maar ons kan.
xh: Izilwanyana zasendle azinxibi zikhafu kwaye azikhalazi. Singafunda into. Asizukufunda, kodwa singafunda.

en: The last log is a decision, not an inventory item.
af: Die laaste blok hout is 'n besluit, nie 'n voorraaditem nie.
xh: Isiqwengana sokugqibela seenkuni sisigqibo, asiyonto nje ekhoyo.

en: Forgot to switch the electric blanket on in advance. Every. Single. Night.
af: Elektriese kombers weer vergeet om vooraf aan te sit. Elke. Enkele. Aand.
xh: Ndilibale ukuvula ingubo yombane kwangethuba. Qho. Ngobusuku. Bonke.

en: The front left. The cold just moved in permanently.
af: Die front is weg. Die koue het net getrek, nie geloop nie.
xh: Ifronti ihambile. Ingqele yona ifudukele apha ngokusisigxina.

en: Today's sky: freshly washed, ice-pressed.
af: Vandag se lug is skoongewas en yskoud gestryk.
xh: Isibhakabhaka sanamhlanje: sisandul' ukuhlanjwa, sayinwa ngumkhenkce.

en: It's a beautiful day to stay indoors.
af: Dis 'n mooi dag om binne te wees.
xh: Lusuku oluhle lokuhlala ngaphakathi.

en: Perfect drying weather. The washing will dry and freeze, in that order.
af: Perfekte wasgoedweer. Die wasgoed gaan droog word én bevries.
xh: Yimozulu efanelekileyo yokomisa impahla. Impahla iza kuoma ize ibe ngumkhenkce, ngolo landelelwano.

en: The shady side of the field is a separate climate zone.
af: Daai skadu-kant van die veld is 'n ander klimaatsone.
xh: Icala elinesithunzi lebala lilizwe lalo ngokwalo.

en: Padstal coffee is functioning as central heating today.
af: Padstalkoffie werk vandag as sentrale verhitting.
xh: Ikofu yepadstal isebenza njengesifudumezi namhlanje.

en: Prettiest moment of the day. Also the shortest. Run.
af: Mooiste tyd van die dag. Kortste ook. Hardloop.
xh: Lelona xesha lihle losuku. Kwaye lelona lifutshane. Baleka.

en: Look quickly. In ten minutes it's night and the North Pole.
af: Kyk mooi. Oor tien minute is dit nag én Noordpool.
xh: Jonga ngokukhawuleza. Kwimizuzu elishumi kuza kuba bubusuku nengqele enkulu.

en: The Karoo is opening its roof for the night. Dress warm for the show.
af: Die Karoo maak nou die dak oop. Trek warm aan vir die vertoning.
xh: IKaroo ivula uphahla lwayo ebusuku. Nxiba iimpahla ezifudumeleyo kumboniso.

en: Rooibos in hand, blanket to the ears. Full kit.
af: Rooibos in die hande, kombers tot by die ore. Volkome uitrusting.
xh: IRooibos esandleni, ingubo ide ifike ezindlebeni. Sizixhobile.

en: No wind, no clouds, no excuse for that thin jacket.
af: Geen wind, geen wolke, geen verskoning om nie warm aan te trek nie.
xh: Akukho moya, akukho mafu, akukho sizathu sale bhatyi ibhityileyo.

en: Breathing like a dragon, view like a dream.
af: Asem soos 'n draak, uitsig soos 'n droom.
xh: Uphefumla ngathi yinamba enomlilo, umbono ngathi liphupha.

en: The berg wind turned overnight. Cape Town, today you're basically Upington.
af: Die bergwind het in die nag gedraai. Kaapstad, vandag is jy Upington.
xh: Umoya oshushu wasezintabeni utshintshe ebusuku. Kapa, namhlanje uphantse ube yi-Upington.

en: The sea is 12 degrees. By ten o'clock it's going to feel like a spa.
af: Die see is 12 grade. Teen tienuur gaan dit soos 'n spa voel.
xh: Ulwandle luziidigri ezili-12. Ngentsimbi yeshumi luza kuziva ngathi yispa.

en: The 5:30 runners aren't fitter than us. They're just smarter.
af: Die 05:30-drawwers is nie fikser as ons nie. Hulle is net slimmer.
xh: Ababalekayo ngo-5:30 abomelele kunathi. Nje bakrelekrele ngakumbi.

en: Even the dog checked the forecast and went straight back to bed.
af: Selfs die hond het die voorspelling gecheck en teruggegaan bed toe.
xh: Nditsho nenja ijonge imozulu yaza yabuyela ebhedini.

en: Bring your own ice. The friendship doesn't cover ice.
af: Bring jou eie ys. Die vriendskap dek nie ys nie.
xh: Yiza nomkhenkce wakho. Ubuhlobo abubandakanyi umkhenkce.

en: The first sip after a 35-degree day should honestly be taxable.
af: Die eerste sluk ná 'n 35-grade dag behoort eerlikwaar belasbaar te wees.
xh: Isiselo sokuqala emva kosuku lweedigri ezingama-35 bekufanele ukuba sihlawulelwe irhafu, inyani.

en: We don't talk about today. Today is over. We're proud of us.
af: Ons praat nie oor vandag nie. Vandag is verby. Ons is trots op ons.
xh: Asithethi nganamhlanje. Namhlanje kuphelile. Siyazingca.

en: The first breeze of the day has just arrived. Give it a round of applause.
af: Die eerste briesie van die dag het nou net opgedaag. Gee hom applous.
xh: Umoya omncinci wokuqala wosuku usandul' ukufika. Wuqhwabele izandla.

en: The farm is still there. We're all just taking each other's word for it.
af: Die plaas is nog daar. Ons vat maar mekaar se woord daarvoor.
xh: Ifama isekhona. Sikholelwa nje kwilizwi lomnye nomnye.

en: The cows know exactly where they are. Which is more than the rest of us can say.
af: Die koeie weet presies waar hulle is. Meer as wat ons kan sê.
xh: Iinkomo ziyazi kanye apho zikhoyo. Ngaphezu koko thina sinokukutsho.

en: Visibility: zero. Mood: surprisingly at peace with it.
af: Sig: nul. Gemoed: verbasend rustig daaroor.
xh: Ukubona: akukho. Isimo sengqondo: sizolile, ngokumangalisayo.

en: Every window switching on is someone deciding: that's enough for today.
af: Elke venster wat aangaan is iemand wat besluit het: genoeg vir vandag.
xh: Yonke ifestile ekhanyayo ngumntu ogqibe kwelokuba: kwanele namhlanje.

en: Fireplace weather showed up without even asking.
af: Kaggelweer het opgedaag sonder om eers te vra.
xh: Imozulu yeziko ifikile ingakhange icele.

en: Perfect weather to bump into someone you've 'been meaning to call'.
af: Perfekte weer om iemand raak te loop wat jy 'nog wou bel'.
xh: Yimozulu efanelekileyo yokudibana nomntu 'obusoloko uceba ukumtsalela umnxeba'.

en: The whole town just switched itself to whisper volume.
af: Die dorp het homself op fluistervolume gesit.
xh: Idolophu yonke izitshintshele kwivolyum yokusebeza.

en: Let's call it atmosphere and go inside.
af: Kom ons noem dit atmosfeer en gaan in.
xh: Masithi yimeko entle, singene ngaphakathi.

en: The sea has vanished but the tannies are here. Priorities.
af: Die see is weg maar die tannies is hier. Prioriteite.
xh: Ulwandle lunyamalele kodwa oomakazi bakhona. Izinto eziphambili.

en: Last one through closes the gate. Even if nobody can see it.
af: Laaste een by die hek maak toe. Al sien niemand dit nie.
xh: Owokugqibela ukudlula uvala isango. Nokuba akukho mntu ulibonayo.

en: Ten pm fog turns every street into a film set.
af: Tienuur se mis maak elke straat 'n fliekstel.
xh: Inkungu yentsimbi yeshumi ebusuku yenza zonke izitrato zibe ziindawo zokwenza ifilimu.

en: The nearest neighbours are thirty kilometres away and tonight they can see you even less.
af: Die naaste bure is dertig kilometer weg en vanaand kan hulle jou nog minder sien.
xh: Abamelwane abakufutshane bakude ngeekhilomitha ezingamashumi amathathu, kwaye ngokuhlwanje abakuboni nakancinci.

en: The sun clocked in before your alarm even tried.
af: Die son het ingeklok voor jou wekker eers probeer het.
xh: Ilanga liqale umsebenzi phambi kokuba i-alamu yakho izame.

en: Zero mistakes from today so far. Sky included.
af: Die dag het nog niks verkeerd gedoen nie. Gee hom kans.
xh: Akukho mpazamo namhlanje ukuza kuthi ga ngoku. Nesibhakabhaka.

en: Highveld mornings: freezing, gorgeous, zero apologies.
af: Hoëveld-oggend: koud genoeg vir 'n jas, mooi genoeg dat jy nie omgee nie.
xh: Iintsasa zaseHighveld: kubanda kakhulu, kuhle, akukho kuxolisa.

en: Weather this well-behaved is definitely up to something.
af: Als dié blou, dié vroeg? Iets broei.
xh: Imozulu eziphethe kakuhle kangaka ngokuqinisekileyo iceba into.

en: Out here even the sun refuses to rush.
af: Hier jaag niemand nie. Die son ook nie.
xh: Apha nditsho nelanga liyala ukungxama.

en: Weather this perfect is on loan. The southeaster keeps receipts.
af: Weer só mooi is nie gratis nie. Iewers wag 'n suidooster.
xh: Imozulu entle kangaka yeyokubolekwa. Umoya wasempuma-mzantsi ugcina iirisithi.

en: The weather made the plans. We just RSVP'd.
af: Die weer het die planne gemaak. Ons het net opgedaag.
xh: Imozulu yenze amacebo. Thina siphendule nje sathi siyeza.

en: Karoo sky: same flawless blue for the next 400 km. Guaranteed.
af: Karoo-blou: presies dieselfde perfekte kleur van hier tot môre.
xh: Isibhakabhaka saseKaroo: luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka olufanayo kwiikhilomitha ezingama-400 ezizayo. Kuqinisekisiwe.

en: The sun is really milking this exit. Honestly, deserved.
af: Die son gaan af soos hy weet ons kyk.
xh: Ilanga lithatha ixesha elide lisiya kutshona. Inyani, liyakufanele.

en: When the weather behaves this well, so do we. Roughly.
af: As die weer só gedra, gedra ons ook. Min of meer.
xh: Xa imozulu iziphethe kakuhle kangaka, nathi siyaziphatha. Phantse.

en: Be honest — you opened this app to confirm Saturday's braai.
af: Check jy die weer, of check jy of Saterdag se braai aan is? Presies.
xh: Yithi inyani — uvule le app ukuze uqinisekise ibraai yangoMgqibelo.

en: A day so good even rush hour felt optional.
af: Die dag was so mooi, selfs die verkeer het saamgespeel.
xh: Usuku oluhle kangangokuba nditsho nexesha lezithuthi ezininzi beliziva ngathi ngumba wokuzikhethela.

en: Midlands mist: the countryside's privacy setting.
af: Midlands-mis: die platteland se privaatheid-instelling.
xh: Inkungu yaseMidlands: indlela amaphandle azifihla ngayo.

en: Walk now or don't walk at all. The Lowveld gives you until seven.
af: Stap nou of stap glad nie. Die Laeveld gee jou tot sewe-uur.
xh: Hamba ngoku okanye ungahambi konke. ILowveld ikunika ixesha de kube yintsimbi yesixhenxe.

en: Even the impala are standing in the shade rethinking their choices.
af: Selfs die rooibokke staan in die skadu en heroorweeg hul keuses.
xh: Nditsho neempala zimi emthunzini ziphinda zicinga ngezigqibo zazo.

en: Lowveld summer: you don't sweat, you melt with dignity.
af: Laeveld-somer: jy sweet nie, jy smelt met waardigheid.
xh: Ihlobo laseLowveld: awubili, unyibilika ngesidima.

en: The bushveld is on silent mode today. Everyone. Everything.
af: Die bosveld is vandag op stille modus. Almal. Alles.
xh: Ihlathi lithe cwaka namhlanje. Wonke umntu. Yonke into.

en: Sundowners aren't a luxury in the Lowveld. They're medical.
af: Sundowners is nie 'n luukse in die Laeveld nie. Dis medies.
xh: Isiselo sokutshona kwelanga asiyonto yobunewunewu eLowveld. Lichiza.

en: Gqeberha, we know. We know.
af: Gqeberha, ons weet. Ons wéét.
xh: Gqeberha, siyazi. Siyazi.

en: The Friendly City never asked to be the Windy City, and yet.
af: Die Vriendelike Stad het nie gevra om die Winderige Stad te wees nie, en tog.
xh: IDolophu enoBubele ayizange icele ukuba yiDolophu enoMoya, kodwa ke.

en: Jeffreys Bay: where the wind warms up before its Cape Town shift.
af: Jeffreysbaai: waar die wind oefen voor sy Kaapse skof.
xh: IJeffreys Bay: apho umoya uzilolonga khona phambi komsebenzi wawo eKapa.

en: Gqeberha doesn't sleep, it just holds on.
af: Gqeberha slaap nie, dit hou net vas.
xh: IGqeberha ayilali, ibambelela nje.
